graph_decision.double_counting_rationale_for_review: Each assessed input is proposed as usage=both (CPT-estimation context + hard observation). Rationale for review: conditioning once in Bayes rule is a single update, not double counting; the LLM conditions table estimates on the patient's context while inference instantiates the same observed states as evidence. Optional missing inputs use estimation context only (the gap is noted in the conditioning context) with no hard evidence, so no update occurs on an unobserved node. Owner to accept or restrict any mapping to observation-only.

graph_decision.why_this_shape: The BN-09 graph is retained verbatim (nodes, states, edges) because it is already on point for the Statement 9 question: a three-input indication flag, two parallel review-need nodes, and one workflow pathway with urgent assessment first. One flat review network over 10 clinician-assessed inputs with 4 query outputs; no latent nodes, no dose nodes, no utility nodes, no posterior chaining into other questions, all discrete nature nodes for the v1 execution profile. Treatment resistance is deliberately not a parent of the indication (per BN-09 and STATEMENT-09, clozapine may reduce aggression risk regardless of formal treatment-resistance criteria). PANSS totals and P7 hostility scores are deliberately never parents; P7 informs the clinician judgment only. Demographics and diagnosis specifics beyond confirmation are explicitly excluded from v0.1; owner decides additions.

independent_examples_provenance.clinical_cases: Ten synthetic author-created cases (1 urgent true-gate, 4 ordinary true-gate pathway branches, 2 false-gate, 1 unknown-gate, 1 required-missing, 1 permitted-unknown) illustrating gate behavior, missingness, and wording. Proposed template branches and clinical expectations are review candidates, not approvals.
independent_examples_provenance.numerical_fixture: Three hand-worked checks by plain enumeration over network.xml bytes, independent of the implementation under test: (1) single-row lookup under complete evidence; (2) prior-marginal P(Indication=Present)=0.101375 from documented root references; (3) transpose/asymmetry detectors on the 4-parent pathway table and the 2-parent plan table. Checks verify ordering plumbing, not clinical correctness.

missing_structured_fields_proposed.basis: STATEMENT-09 requires a clinician judgment of substantial aggression risk with date, behavior/threat history, symptoms/context, instrument/version/window if used, and rationale. PANSS P7 (1-7) informs the judgment but no score alone satisfies the gate.

STATEMENT-09 requires persistence despite other treatments with reviewed treatments, dates, response, and adherence; no history field records this determination. Not two failed trials; not treatment resistance.
Immediate danger to others or self and serious suspected treatment harm need a structured current-encounter record feeding the deterministic urgent flag independent of LLM latency.
STATEMENT-09 Implementation points to modifiable risk factors (via Statement 3) as plan targets; no structured field exists.

missing_structured_fields_proposed.period: current_encounter for current treatment; historical_event_dates for prior exposure
missing_structured_fields_proposed.basis: Current versus prior versus never clozapine exposure as status only (FR-14 excludes dose/duration/route/frequency); medications list alone does not distinguish current from prior exposure.
Patient Preferences section requires willingness discussion; willingness is not consent and must be recorded separately.
Implementation and Harms sections require a feasible monitoring and follow-up plan per current local guidance; logistical barriers (for example transportation, blood-work access) belong here.
Benefit-harm, contraindication, and interaction review (with the separate DDI report referenced, never substituted) needs a structured completion record.

owner_questions: Q1: Confirm the proposed aggression vocabulary and assessment periods (current-encounter judgments; historical_interval persistence support; historical_event_dates for prior clozapine exposure), including the PANSS currency window choice.
Q2: Confirm the PANSS-hostility boundary: P7 (1-7) and any scale score inform the clinician judgment only and never satisfy the substantial-risk gate; a low score alone never yields No.

Q3: Confirm that persistence is documented persistence despite other treatments with treatments/dates/response/adherence reviewed, without regimen detail (FR-14), with no count threshold, and distinct from treatment resistance.

Q4: Confirm the urgent-assessment handling: Present (immediate danger to others or self, or serious suspected treatment harm) fires the deterministic urgent flag from saved inputs without waiting for any LLM output; Absent never certifies safety.

Q5: Confirm the required-versus-optional classification (gate triad, urgent assessment, and clozapine exposure status block on missing; adherence, modifiable targets, willingness, monitoring plan, and medical review permit inference with disclosure) and approve, amend, or replace the eight proposed structured fields in missing_structured_fields_proposed.

Q6: Confirm the six-state pathway vocabulary and the predefined template wording, including the no-argmax rule (physician always decides; no branch starts, restarts, continues, stops, doses, or clears clozapine).

Q7: Clarify the R6 versus treatment-resistance and R7 boundaries: R6 is the registration aggression-risk indication; formal treatment resistance is deliberately not a parent. Confirm no shared package identity is wanted.
Q8: Confirm the monitoring-plan and medical-review scope (feasibility per current local guidance; DDI report stays a separate informational report and never substitutes for the review).

question_enumeration.applicability: Registration encounters whose reviewed gate holds: schizophrenia confirmed AND substantial current aggression risk documented by clinician judgment AND persistence despite other treatments documented. False gate records not_applicable with reason (no inference, no CPTs, no posterior); unknown gate records needs_clarification and stops later questions.
question_enumeration.intended_setting: General adult clinician-led schizophrenia treatment review as described in STATEMENT-09, covering first-time and established presentations at registration. Not an emergency-department triage instrument and not a prescribing system; urgent findings follow local emergency protocol. Local setting confirmation requested.

output_meanings.DiscussClozapine: Review prompt: the Statement 9 indication is documented; discuss clozapine per local prescribing information. Not a prescription, not consent, never a start order.
output_meanings.DiscussClozapineAndAddressReviewNeeds: Review prompt: indication documented; discuss clozapine and address flagged review needs in the same encounter. Never a start order.
output_meanings.IndividualizedPriorClozapineReview: Review prompt: prior clozapine exposure requires individualized benefit/harm and discontinuation-history review. No authorization of restarting or withholding.
output_meanings.ReviewCurrentClozapine: Review prompt: patient presently receiving clozapine; review current benefit, risk, adherence, effects, monitoring. No authorization of continuation, change, or stopping.
output_meanings.ReviewEvidenceAndOtherIndications: Review prompt: the aggression-risk indication is not established on recorded inputs; review evidence completeness and consider other indications. Never a recommendation against clozapine and never a negative risk finding.
output_meanings.UrgentClinicalAssessment: Review prompt: urgent clinical assessment first per local emergency protocol; clozapine discussion follows after safety is addressed.

question_enumeration.proposed_time_horizon: Current clinical review with documented prior treatment history; no prospective aggression-risk horizon is proposed (per BN-09 time_horizon and STATEMENT-09, which states no forward risk period). Owner to confirm.
question_enumeration.specific_question: For an adult registration encounter with a reviewed aggression gate, given the documented indication inputs, urgent assessment, clozapine exposure, and parallel review needs, what are the posterior distributions over the Statement 9 (2C suggestion) clozapine-review prompts, to structure physician discussion and review?

reference_table_provenance.forbidden: No empirical probabilities were manufactured; no guideline evidence rating (2C, low strength) was converted into a probability; no PANSS item or scale level was converted into a risk percentage.
reference_table_provenance.rule: Roots use fixed illustrative distributions (for example SubstantialAggressionRisk [0.30,0.70], ClozapineTreatmentStatus [0.70,0.10,0.20]). Indication rows: all-Yes [0.90,0.10], (Yes,Yes,No) [0.15,0.85], (Yes,No,*) [0.05,0.95], (No,*,*) [0.02,0.98]. Plan-review rows: 0.88 on the deterministic diagonal, 0.04 elsewhere. Preparation rows: (Yes,Yes,Yes) [0.12,0.88], all else [0.88,0.12]. Pathway rows: 0.82 on the deterministic argmax state, 0.036 on each of the other five. Every synthetic row preserves its deterministic BN-09 source argmax without 0/1 hardness. The lookup exists only to give the validator and inference harness complete, normalized, correctly ordered tables. Never present these as patient estimates.
reference_table_provenance.status: synthetic structural placeholder only; zero clinical validity

review_notice: Draft for owner review. Nothing in this package is clinically approved, estimates no aggression probability, predicts no aggression, authorizes no clozapine prescribing action, encodes no aggression threshold or law, and conflates nothing with treatment resistance. Do not activate.

source_classification.drafting_lead: BN-09 Statement09_Clozapine_Aggression_Risk_Review_Draft is an incomplete, inference-disabled and deployment-disabled drafting lead (missing priors, deterministic 0/1 workflow tables), not an approved mapping. Nodes, states, and edges are retained verbatim; tables are replaced as documented. BN-09 itself is untouched.
source_classification.proposed_for_review: Agent-proposed graph retention rationale, gate composition, periods, transforms, horizons, wording, required/optional classification, and reference values; not source-derived clinical rules.
source_classification.source_derived: Statements reproduced or conservatively constrained from the cited sources without adding a clinical threshold, a risk cutoff, a law, or a probability.

source_comparison.bn09_deterministic_vs_allcpt: The four BN-09 0/1 workflow tables are documented modeler assumptions, not validated clinical rules. The package replaces them with soft synthetic placeholders preserving each row's deterministic argmax (0.90/0.88/0.88/0.82 on the deterministic state). Every CPT including roots is estimated under the all-CPT contract with no registered-table fallback. Originals are preserved untouched in BNs/BN-09.xml.
source_comparison.no_treatment_resistance_conflation: Persistence despite other treatments is not two failed antipsychotic trials and not treatment resistance. Formal treatment resistance is deliberately not a parent of the indication, and the R6 versus treatment-resistance/R7 boundary is an owner question (Q7).
source_comparison.panss_hostility_not_gate: PANSS hostility item P7 (1-7) and any other scale score inform the clinician's substantial-risk judgment but never satisfy the gate; no score maps to Yes by itself and an unassessed PANSS can never yield Yes. A low scale score alone never maps to No. No PANSS total, band, or cutoff is encoded.
source_comparison.statement01_risk_factors_context_only: STATEMENT-01 demographic and historical aggression risk factors are static background context; potentially modifiable factors serve as treatment-plan attention targets only. No checklist, demographic, or historical rule determines aggression risk in this package.

No dedicated urgent-assessment instrument is proposed; the urgent field records clinician judgment of immediate danger or suspected harm.
Modifiable-target collection instrument and Statement 3 linkage are proposals.
Clozapine exposure status required (blocking) versus optional is a proposal (owner to confirm in Q5).
Monitoring-plan feasibility follows current local guidance, which is not encoded.
Medical-review scope (benefit-harm, contraindication, interaction) and its separation from the DDI report are proposals.
Deterministic urgent flag versus estimated pathway resolution (flag shown first, never replaced by the posterior) is a proposal.
No prospective aggression-risk horizon is proposed; posteriors are review prompts, never aggression probabilities.
Reference tables are synthetic placeholders with zero clinical validity.
R6 versus treatment-resistance/R7 boundaries are proposed as distinct packages.
